$$

$$
\begin{aligned}-2\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}-6 \\ -4\end{bmatrix}\ne \begin{bmatrix}-6 \\ -6\end{bmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$
